title: Research Rover
statementMd:
*Unfortunately, the formal description of the task turned out to be too long, so here is the legend.*

Research rover finally reached the surface of Mars and is ready to complete its mission. Unfortunately, due to the mistake in the navigation system design, the rover is located in the wrong place.

The rover will operate on the grid consisting of $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns. We will define as $(*r*, *c*)$ the cell located in the row $*r*$ and column $*c*$. From each cell the rover is able to move to any cell that share a side with the current one.

The rover is currently located at cell $(1, 1)$ and has to move to the cell $(*n*, *m*)$. It will randomly follow some **shortest path** between these two cells. Each possible way is chosen equiprobably.

The cargo section of the rover contains the battery required to conduct the research. Initially, the battery charge is equal to $*s*$ units of energy.

Some of the cells contain anomaly. Each time the rover gets to the cell with anomaly, the battery looses half of its charge rounded down. Formally, if the charge was equal to $*x*$ before the rover gets to the cell with anomaly, the charge will change to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f12f73ab57d327f2f2cb7c8de54e8e6e246f6b2e.png).

While the rover picks a random shortest path to proceed, compute the expected value of the battery charge after it reaches cell $(*n*, *m*)$. If the cells $(1, 1)$ and $(*n*, *m*)$ contain anomaly, they also affect the charge of the battery.

## Input

The first line of the input contains four integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*k*$ and $*s*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 2000$, $1 ≤ *s* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the number of rows and columns of the field, the number of cells with anomaly and the initial charge of the battery respectively.

The follow $*k*$ lines containing two integers $*r*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$) — coordinates of the cells, containing anomaly. It's guaranteed that each cell appears in this list no more than once.

## Output

The answer can always be represented as an irreducible fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46898f7da6d890f88194a3d5535e5e990ecdd3fa.png). Print the only integer $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

In the first sample, the rover picks one of the following six routes:

1. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9ec158c30775d6289140a3854e05168b09af399.png), after passing cell $(2, 3)$ charge is equal to $6$.
2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcc490c05d2acb731046a7c4c861f4c9ebff3633.png), after passing cell $(2, 3)$ charge is equal to $6$.
3. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d5828aadc35714d7a3453c40de81ad186e87ab3.png), charge remains unchanged and equals $11$.
4. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3bc680a61ca3712bbbec0eb682f3af16ab7664a2.png), after passing cells $(2, 1)$ and $(2, 3)$ charge equals $6$ and then $3$.
5. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a87005ef2b3eb1efc9e486e608fadf3a5b557fa.png), after passing cell $(2, 1)$ charge is equal to $6$.
6. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/342ddbff927874c07e9d307d73383aa50f2117b6.png), after passing cell $(2, 1)$ charge is equal to $6$.

Expected value of the battery charge is calculated by the following formula:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ddca3ad80b71df649b7beb01944a4ad8f863265.png).

Thus $*P* = 19$, and $*Q* = 3$.

$3^{ - 1}$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$ equals $333333336$.

$19·333333336 = 333333342 (*mod* 10^{9} + 7)$
statementZhMd:
*很遗憾，任务的正式描述实在太长了，所以这里给出故事背景。*

科研探测车终于到达了火星表面，准备完成它的任务。然而，由于导航系统设计上的失误，探测车目前位于错误的位置。

探测车将在一个由 $*n*$ 行和 $*m*$ 列组成的网格上运行。我们将第 $*r*$ 行第 $*c*$ 列的单元格记为 $(*r*, *c*)$。探测车可以从任意单元格移动到与当前单元格共享一条边的任意单元格。

探测车当前位于单元格 $(1, 1)$，需要移动到单元格 $(*n*, *m*)$。它将随机选择这两个单元格之间的某条**最短路径**。每种可能的路径被选中的概率相同。

探测车的货舱中装有进行研究所需的电池。初始时，电池电量为 $*s*$ 单位能量。

部分单元格中含有异常。每当探测车到达一个含有异常的单元格时，电池电量会减少一半并向下取整。形式化地说，如果探测车到达含有异常的单元格之前电量为 $*x*$，那么电量将变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f12f73ab57d327f2f2cb7c8de54e8e6e246f6b2e.png)。

在探测车随机选择一条最短路径行进的情况下，求它到达单元格 $(*n*, *m*)$ 后电池电量的期望值。如果单元格 $(1, 1)$ 和 $(*n*, *m*)$ 含有异常，它们也会影响电池电量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含四个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*k*$ 和 $*s*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 2000$，$1 ≤ *s* ≤ 1 000 000$）——网格的行数和列数、含有异常的单元格数量以及电池的初始电量。

接下来的 $*k*$ 行每行包含两个整数 $*r*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$）——含有异常的单元格的坐标。保证每个单元格在该列表中至多出现一次。

## 输出格式

答案总可以表示为一个既约分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46898f7da6d890f88194a3d5535e5e990ecdd3fa.png)。请输出唯一的整数 $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ 对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，探测车会选择以下六条路径之一：

1. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9ec158c30775d6289140a3854e05168b09af399.png)，经过单元格 $(2, 3)$ 后电量为 $6$。
2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcc490c05d2acb731046a7c4c861f4c9ebff3633.png)，经过单元格 $(2, 3)$ 后电量为 $6$。
3. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d5828aadc35714d7a3453c40de81ad186e87ab3.png)，电量不变，仍为 $11$。
4. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3bc680a61ca3712bbbec0eb682f3af16ab7664a2.png)，经过单元格 $(2, 1)$ 和 $(2, 3)$ 后，电量分别变为 $6$ 和 $3$。
5. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a87005ef2b3eb1efc9e486e608fadf3a5b557fa.png)，经过单元格 $(2, 1)$ 后电量为 $6$。
6. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/342ddbff927874c07e9d307d73383aa50f2117b6.png)，经过单元格 $(2, 1)$ 后电量为 $6$。

电池电量的期望值按照以下公式计算：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ddca3ad80b71df649b7beb01944a4ad8f863265.png)。

因此 $*P* = 19$，$*Q* = 3$。

$3^{ - 1}$ 对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果为 $333333336$。

$19·333333336 = 333333342 (*mod* 10^{9} + 7)$
